title: CS 4535: Checkpoint 2
description: Due Thu Nov 5, 23:59 ET. Judgment returned within a week.
completedHtml:
Checkpoint 2 submitted.

Your team's review and your individual judgment come back within a week. The Game Day 2 postmortem (Nov 5) is due within 48 hours of the game day.

elements.name: intro
elements.html: About 15 minutes if your work is linked. Where you can, paste a link. The layout follows the Learning Summary Report: each requirement, then the link that shows it. Checkpoint 3 asks the same things, so whatever you put here carries forward. We read this alongside your team's review and send back a written judgment within a week: on track for your declared band or not, and why. See Project Milestones & Checkpoints.

elements.description: If it's a stack, link the last PR and list the others in the next box.

elements.name: ft_more

elements.description: Optional. A revert, a fix-forward, or a review that changed the design all belong here.
